diff --git a/lizard_languages/javascript_functions.py b/lizard_languages/javascript_functions.py
index acc9ea985..afeb96c91 100644
--- a/lizard_languages/javascript_functions.py
+++ b/lizard_languages/javascript_functions.py
@@ -137,8 +137,9 @@ class JavaScriptFunctionsMixin:
             return
         if token == '<':
             # Generic type params: function name<T>(...) — consume <...>
-            # so function_name (already set) is preserved.
-            self._consume_generic_type_params()
+            # so function_name (already set) is preserved and "(" still
+            # opens the parameters.
+            self._consume_generic_type_params(self._function)
             return
         if token.startswith('<') and token.endswith('>') and len(token) > 1:
             # Single-token generic from TSX tokenizer (e.g., <T>, <Props>)
diff --git a/lizard_languages/typescript_declarations.py b/lizard_languages/typescript_declarations.py
index 92b149dab..53a89bb4e 100644
--- a/lizard_languages/typescript_declarations.py
+++ b/lizard_languages/typescript_declarations.py
@@ -137,9 +137,10 @@ class TypeScriptDeclarationsMixin:
         return ((self._prev_token == '.' or token not in _EXPRESSION_PREFIXES)
                 and (ends_expression(token) or token.isidentifier()))
 
-    def _consume_generic_type_params(self):
+    def _consume_generic_type_params(self, resume=None):
         """Consume <...> generic type parameters (e.g., method<T>(...))
-        so the method name in last_tokens is preserved."""
+        so the method name in last_tokens is preserved; then continue in
+        resume (the global state by default)."""
         depth = 1
 
         def consume(token):
@@ -149,7 +150,7 @@ class TypeScriptDeclarationsMixin:
             elif token == '>':
                 depth -= 1
                 if depth == 0:
-                    self.next(self._state_global)
+                    self.next(resume or self._state_global)
         self.next(consume)
 
     def _consume_type_annotation(self):
diff --git a/test/test_languages/testTypeScriptFunctions.py b/test/test_languages/testTypeScriptFunctions.py
index 915cf49fb..02c74660e 100644
--- a/test/test_languages/testTypeScriptFunctions.py
+++ b/test/test_languages/testTypeScriptFunctions.py
@@ -128,6 +128,21 @@ class Test_TypeScript_generic_arrow_functions(unittest.TestCase):
         functions = get_ts_function_list(code)
         self.assertEqual(["identity"], [f.name for f in functions])
 
+    def test_generic_function_declaration(self):
+        """function first<T>(list: T[]) {} keeps its parameters after <T>"""
+        code = '''
+            export function first<T>(list: T[]) {
+                return list[0];
+            }
+            function pair<T, U extends object>(a: T, b: U): T {
+                return a;
+            }
+        '''
+        functions = get_ts_function_list(code)
+        self.assertEqual([("first", 2, 4, ["list"]), ("pair", 5, 7, ["a", "b"])],
+                         [(f.name, f.start_line, f.end_line, f.parameters)
+                          for f in functions])
+
 
 
 class Test_TypeScript_export_patterns(unittest.TestCase):

             return
         self.last_tokens += token
         self._state = self._state_global
+
+    def _expecting_condition_and_statement_block(self, token):
+        def callback():
+            self.next(self._expecting_statement_or_block)
+
+        if token == "await":
+            return
+
+        if token != '(':
+            self.next(self._state_global, token)
+            return
+
+        if self._condition_kind == 'catch':
+            def catch_callback(summary):
+                self.context.add_condition(summary.defaults)
+                callback()
+
+            self._read_binding_candidate(
+                ')', catch_callback, track_complexity=False)
+            return
+
+        self.sub_state(
+            self.__class__(self.context), callback)
+
+    def _expecting_statement_or_block(self, token):
+        def callback():
+            self._prev_token = ''
+            self.next(self._state_global)
+        if token == "{":
+            self.sub_state(
+                self.__class__(self.context), callback)
+        else:
+            self._prev_token = ''
+            self.next(self._state_global, token)
+
+    def _state_template_literal(self, token):
+        if token == '`':
+            self.next(self._state_global)
